name: GPU.ai - H100 SXM (Secure tier)
price_basis: per H100 SXM GPU-hour, secure tier (vetted datacenter capacity), on-demand. Fetched 2026-10-04. Per-second billing. Zero markup claim (raw provider rates). Community tier is $3.36/GPU-hr.
notes: GPU.ai H100 SXM at $3.49/GPU-hr (secure tier) is 13% below Together AI's on-demand ($3.99), 45% below CoreWeave ($6.16), and 49% below AWS p5 ($6.88). The community tier at $3.36 is slightly cheaper but carries higher risk (independent marketplace suppliers). GPU.ai is an aggregator, so this rate is composed of underlying cloud rates from 12+ providers. The market range for H100 SXM is $6.16-$11.06/GPU-hr across major clouds. GPU.ai's rate is below the entire market range, which is notable.
